study: Historical held-out test of the day desk's entry and exit variants: does the live code, run on past sessions it has never seen (synthetic-day replay), make money after cost with (a) the %R + RSI direction entry and/or (b) exits that do not stomp runs (leash off + Pivot SuperTrend)?
registered_at: 2026-10-10 ~13:30 ET, before the synthetic-day mode or the historical universe exist and before any held-out day is replayed
origin: Operator 10/10: 'time is of the essence' -> test on held-out past sessions instead of waiting 6-9 weeks for fresh ones (docs/studies/HIST_SIM_PLAN_2026-10-10.md). Combination asked for: '%R and RSI direction change with exits not stomping out profit runs'.
prior: LOW for profit. Every entry setup has matched random minutes (entry-setups-are-noise-equivalent); exits have never moved the gross mean (exits-cannot-move-the-mean, 42 shapes); the desk nets ~-3 bp/trade at ~3 bp spread. In-sample 10/10 quick look on 416 trades: '%R and RSI both rising' +0.1 bp gross on SIP bars but -2.1 on IEX (the feed live uses), i.e. ~+0.5 bp over %R alone. SuperTrend exit: no evidence yet (replay mirror fixed 72e95a9). Weekend counterfactual batches 1-2 (seen sessions, information only) may be read before this test runs; they cannot change anything below.

data.held_out_window: every regular trading day 2026-03-02 .. 2026-09-23 (no session recordings exist; this strategy was never run on them). Days the pipeline cannot build (data errors, half days) are listed and excluded before any outcome is computed; the list is frozen in the run log before scoring. EXCLUSION CRITERIA (frozen now): a day is excluded only for (a) market half day, (b) SPY minute bars missing > 5% of RTH, (c) > 10% of universe names with failed bar fetches after retries, (d) > 10% of a variant's trades lacking an SIP NBBO at entry. Nothing else. A day excluded under (d) for ANY variant is excluded for ALL variants (keeps the paired legs aligned).
data.calibration_days: 2026-09-24 .. 2026-10-09 (recorded, seen): used ONLY for universe recall and synthetic-day fidelity, never scored here.
data.universe: tools/studies/hist_universe.py (workstream U): point-in-time reconstruction of the movers / tight admissions with RAW-price floors; trending / agy / xai / bb_live AND momentum (Discord [ELITE] scanner alerts, found by WS-U 10/10) are not reconstructable and are absent (stated coverage on the calibration days). Symbol master: point-in-time, active AND delisted/inactive assets (allsym assets incl. inactive), stated in the run log. Admission rules use only data that CLOSED before the admission minute (no same-day daily bars). Prior close, gap %, price floors/caps all on RAW (unadjusted) prices.
data.engine: tools/replay_session.py --universe (workstream R) with --engine recompute --engine-bars iex PINNED (live computes %R on IEX; the 10/10 quick look flips sign SIP vs IEX). Synthetic ENTRY fills at the first SIP trade print strictly after the decision time (no print within 60 s -> no fill, counted); synthetic EXIT fills at the first SIP print after the exit decision. Never at a completed-bar close (shadow-price bias, skeptic 1).
data.config: ONE fixed config for every held-out day: the live config/bot_config.json as of the 2026-10-09 close (presquare-only entry, np180 on, left-overbought/triangle exit OFF - switched off 2026-10-08 10:40 ET, a37bb09, because live %R fell back to raw on thin IEX windows; leash as live), sha-pinned and logged; variants differ only by the --set lines below.
data.costing: tools/studies/replay_costing.py: net = replay ret - the FULL SIP spread at entry, charged ONCE as the round-trip cost (the synthetic price path is last-trade prints, not bid/ask). A trade with no NBBO is charged that day's pooled median across variants and counted; a day with > 10% such trades is excluded (criterion d). replay_costing currently drops no-NBBO trades; the median substitute is implemented in hist_sim_read.py before the run.

variants.rand_wrrsi: + ai_watch_wr_rand_refuse_share = 1 - (wrrsi trades / base trades) for that day (two-pass), the trade-less control for the entry filter Achieved trade count must be within +-15% of wrrsi's that day, else that day's rand leg is invalid (counted). There is no random control for wrrsi_st itself; the vs-base leg stands in.

statistic: Scored day = a held-out day not excluded by the frozen criteria. Absolute leg: per scored day, net bp per trade over that day's trades (days with 0 trades of the variant are excluded from the bp/trade leg, counted) and net $/day at $1k per trade (0-trade days = $0, included). Paired leg vs base: std_scorer.paired_variants (same symbol and entry within 5 s, nearest match) for same-entry differences AND, as the leg of record, the per-day difference of per-day net bp/trade over days where both variants have >= 1 trade. t = std_scorer.day_stat (max of plain and Newey-West(5) SE).

fidelity_gate.when: BEFORE any held-out replay, on the 12 calibration days 2026-09-24..10-09, variants base, st and wrrsi_st.
fidelity_gate.A_engine: synthetic-day replay fed the RECORDED watchlist vs the recorded replay (same config): per variant pooled |diff in net bp/trade| <= 1.5 bp; per-day |diff| <= 6 bp on >= 9 of 12 days; >= 65% of recorded-replay trades reproduced within 90 s; PAIRED: |(synthetic wrrsi_st - base) - (recorded wrrsi_st - base)| <= 1.5 bp pooled.
fidelity_gate.B_end_to_end: hist_universe + synthetic vs the recorded replay: recall of recorded movers+tight admissions >= 70% (within 10 min of first admission), recall of recorded-replay TRADED names from those sources >= 70%; the same paired condition (<= 1.5 bp) and |diff in net bp/trade| <= 3 bp for each variant.
fidelity_gate.fail: any condition fails -> the held-out run is NOT scored under this prereg; the numbers are stated either way.
fidelity_gate.note: Part A compares synthetic next-print fills with the recorded replay's recorded-price fills, so the fill model itself is inside the gap (conservative). If the gate fails, fill rules are NOT changed under this prereg; a new prereg is required.

pass.primary: wrrsi_st: (1) absolute: mean net bp/trade > 0 with t >= 2.0 AND mean net $/day > 0 with t >= 2.0; (2) vs base: per-day paired difference >= +3 bp/trade with t >= 2.0; (3) both window halves (2026-03-02..06-11 and 06-12..09-23) have absolute net bp/trade > 0; (4) the LEAST-SEEN sub-window 2026-03-02..04-30 alone has absolute net bp/trade > 0 and paired difference > 0 (2026-05..09 overlaps ~15 earlier study windows the live config was tuned on); (5) >= 60 scored days and >= 600 wrrsi_st trades.
pass.secondary: wr15, wrrsi, st, nodecay each vs base, and wrrsi vs rand_wrrsi: reported with t; any 'better than base' claim needs t >= 2.6 (Bonferroni over 5 legs) and same sign in both halves. Secondaries cannot rescue a failed primary; an absolute-profit claim for any secondary needs a new prereg on fresh sessions.
pass.on_pass: skeptic review, then a live PAPER A/B of wrrsi_st vs live (names split by sha256(symbol|day)); the fresh-session tests (wr_trend_entry, supertrend_exit_forward) continue as confirmation.
pass.fail: anything else. UNDERPOWERED (< 60 scored days or < 600 trades) = FAIL.

power: MEASURED before the held-out run: the per-day sd of wrrsi_st net bp/trade and of the paired difference from the calibration-day synthetic runs is written to the run log; with that sd the minimum detectable effect at 80% power over the scored days is stated. If MDE > 4 bp the run still proceeds but the log states that a FAIL is uninformative about effects below the MDE.
information_only: trades/day per variant; exit reasons; hold times
results by universe source (movers / tight / momentum)
results by price band (<$10 excluded by config; $10-50; >$50)
calibration-day results of every variant (seen, not scored)
the slots/concurrency effect: concurrent positions per variant
no_retuning: 15 %R points, 10 RSI points, 10-minute windows, SuperTrend 2/3/10, the fixed config, the window and the variants are fixed here. Any change after a held-out result is seen is a new prereg on a new window.
caveats: the universe lacks trending / agy / xai / bb_live / momentum names (momentum = Discord scanner alerts); results hold for movers + tight only; share of calibration-day admissions and trades covered is stated in the run log
the synthetic engine is not the live engine; fidelity gate above bounds it on calibration days only
one fixed config on all days is not what live ran on those days (live was different / not running); this tests the CURRENT strategy on past tape
market regime 2026-03..09 may differ from the coming weeks
entry and exit fill at the first SIP print after the decision; the full entry spread is charged once as the round trip
